Customer Success Manager
description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager (CSM) to drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term value realization for our products. This role involves designing and executing customer success journeys, enabling customers to maximize product investments, and serving as a trusted advisor who bridges technology, analytics, AI capabilities, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate will combine strategic thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making to deliver impactful customer outcomes. 
 Role: Customer Success Manager Location: Hyderabad Experience: 8 to 12 years Job Type: Full-Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Design and manage onboarding, adoption, and customer success journeys tailored to client needs and product use cases. Partner with customers to understand business goals and demonstrate how products drive measurable value and outcomes. Simplify and communicate complex product capabilities, including AI-driven features, into actionable customer use cases. Execute targeted engagement programs and adoption campaigns using Gainsight CS, Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot, or similar platforms. Analyze customer usage data, feedback, and adoption metrics to identify opportunities, close adoption gaps, and improve success strategies. Create visually engaging and brand-aligned customer communications, presentations, and success materials. Collaborate with Product Management, Marketing, and Support teams to advocate for customer needs, influence product improvements, and ensure effective feedback loops. Drive customer engagement initiatives that improve product utilization, retention, and overall satisfaction. Deliver executive-level presentations, product value stories, and success narratives to stakeholders. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer success, adoption frameworks, and engagement strategies. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 Bachelors or Masters degree in Business, Technology, or a related discipline. 8-12 years of experience in Customer Success, Product Marketing, Customer Engagement, or similar client-facing roles within SaaS or product-based organizations. Strong understanding of enterprise software, digital products, and customer adoption strategies. Experience translating AI-driven product capabilities into business value and customer outcomes. Hands-on experience with Gainsight CS and/or marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, Eloqua, or Pardot. Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, storytelling, and presentation skills. Strong design and branding awareness with proficiency in PowerPoint and customer-facing content creation. Experience working with customer usage analytics, adoption metrics, and engagement reporting. Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success teams. Experience with customer journey mapping, onboarding programs, retention strategies, and product adoption frameworks. Good knowledge of creative tools such as Photoshop, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, and visual content development. Experience in video editing, multimedia creation, and customer communication assets is a plus. Passion for customer success, technology adoption, AI-enabled solutions, and driving measurable business outcomes. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents 
 Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: 
 Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. 
 We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

 "Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."

title: Customer support travel specialist
description:
Customer support travel specialist 
Our philosophy for customer service is simple: Listen to the customer. Understand their needs. Take ownership. Solve the problem. When a customer contacts Miraee, you take the responsibility till the need is addressed or the issue is solved. You will own urgent disruptions, complex multi-leg trips, VIP requests, and edge cases the AI agents couldn't resolve. Our customers include CEOs, CFOs, senior executives, executive assistants, and frequent business travelers with urgent and complex travel needs. 
 You will own four KPIs: First-Response Time (FRT) Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Ownership Rate End-to-End Issue Resolution 
 What you will do Handle flight changes, cancellations, rebooking, delays, missed connections, and other travel disruptions especially last-minute and complex requests. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, car rentals, rail, airport transfers, and ground transportation when the frequent travelers are in need. Flag recurring pain points and agent failure patterns to Product and Engineering so the AI improves - you are a key input to our product feedback loop. Support travelers with check-in, seat and upgrade requests, and hotel needs such as early check-in and late checkout. Assist with restaurant bookings, private dinners, meetings, conferences, and other business travel needs. Understand the traveler's schedule and recommend the best available option. Work directly with airlines, hotels, and travel partners to resolve customer issues. Support customers across phone, chat, email, and messaging; keep them updated until the issue is fully resolved. Escalate account-level or program-level issues to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager; you own the traveler, they own the account. 
 Experience needed 3 - 5 years in corporate travel, business travel, airline ticketing, travel agency, or travel customer support. Hands-on experience with at least one GDS: Sabre, Amadeus, Apollo, Galileo, or Travelport. Experience handling US domestic and international travel. Experience supporting business travelers, senior executives, VIPs, or frequent travelers. Strong understanding of flight bookings, changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, and fare rules. Experience handling travel disruptions and last-minute changes. Prior experience at a corporate travel desk or travel management company preferred. 
 Skills we value Excellent spoken and written English. Strong attention to detail. Sound problem-solving and decision-making. Comfortable with demanding travelers with complex needs. Able to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Takes ownership instead of passing problems along. Comfortable with travel technology and quick to learn new systems including working alongside AI agents.

Key Skills: GDS,Travel Management,Corporate Travel Management,Galileo,Air Ticketing,Communication Skills,Ticketing,Sabre
